build.reason: The recipe compiles fuzz_1.c, whose seven-argument scrub_message call is incompatible with the supplied eight-parameter definition.

input.reason: For nonempty supplied bytes under normal allocation, the entry copies the bytes into a packet buffer and passes that buffer to the packet parser.

lifecycle.reason: The scrub call supplies iter_env in the seventh position, which the definition reserves for qstate, and supplies no eighth iter_env argument.

control_flow.reason: Successful parsing reaches the incompatible scrub call; the call cannot correctly enter the supplied scrub_message interface.

accepted.requirement: Call scrub_message with both a module_qstate pointer as its seventh argument and an iter_env pointer as its eighth argument.
accepted.target_route: After parse_packet and EDNS extraction succeed, LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput initializes env and ie and calls scrub_message.
accepted.failure_condition: The old call provides only seven arguments, placing &ie where qstate belongs and omitting ie. It is incompatible with the supplied function interface.
accepted.alternative_paths: The complete entry has one scrub_message call and no other route to its scrubbing operation.
